name: expense-voucher-management-system
description: Full-stack Expense Voucher Management System with multi-role approval workflow

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
